newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all weaker, but fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all weaker, but fuel oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products all fell on Thursday with the exception of high sulphur fuel oil.
Gasoline barges ended $8 lower at $202/$204 for Eurograde, hurt by crude, a shut arb to the U.S. and sluggish local demand.
Naphtha cargoes fell a notional $6-$7 to $223/$226 cif as the tight grip on prompt supply lightened up, at least temporarily.
High sulphur fuel oil was flat but low sulphur fuel lost around $2 to talk under $100 fob NWE.
Heating oil dropped by up to $5 a tonne pressured by weaker premiums and sharply depressed futures.
